newsitem.title: TUNISIA: BG Tunisian plant shuts for one month work.
newsitem.headline: BG Tunisian plant shuts for one month work.

text.p: Britain's BG Plc's gas treatment plant near the Tunisian southern city of Sfax had been closed for a one-month period to allow a scheduled technical maintenance, the company said in a statement published in Tunis on Thursday.
It said the plant was closed since June 15 for a routine 28-day maintenance to be carried out each one and a half year.

The onshore Hannibal plant last year started processing production from the company's offshore Miskar gas field. Typical gas production level from the plant was set at around 4.5 billion cubic metres per day.
The gas is sold to the Tunisian state-run Societe Tunisienne de l'Electricite et du Gaz (STEG) which said that the temporary closure of Hannibal plant didn't affect supplies for its power plants.
It said it had turned to fuel oil thanks to falling world prices.
